question_stem: Positron emission tomography (PET) is used in medical imaging.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a medical tracer.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Fluorine-18 decays by $\beta^+$ emission. Write the nuclear equation for this decay.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State the type of particle that is emitted with the positron.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.part_stem: A positron annihilates with an electron to produce two $\gamma$-ray photons.
parts.text: Show that the minimum energy of each $\gamma$-ray photon is $8.2 \times 10^{-14}\text{ J}$.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the wavelength of each $\gamma$-ray photon.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Describe how the $\gamma$-ray photons are detected and used to produce an image in PET scanning.
